ABOUT LAURA

Developer, designer.
Laura.

I’m Laura Ortega, a web developer and designer based in Barquisimeto, Venezuela. I build websites for clients directly, through Upwork and as part of the team at Honorable Marketing.

Most of my recent work is in Webflow: full builds, CMS structure, English and Spanish localization, on-page SEO and platform migrations. I also develop WordPress websites with Oxygen and Elementor when the project calls for it.

My background in telematics engineering helps me think beyond the layout. I care about site structure, performance, accessibility and making content manageable for the people who own the website.

EXPERIENCE & EDUCATION

How I got here.

2020 / NOW

Freelance Web Developer

Webflow and WordPress projects for direct clients and through Upwork. Recent work includes JuryBall Vegas, Her Vitality Clinic and Men’s Vitality Clinic.

2024 / NOW

Honorable Marketing

Contract Webflow work from July 2024, followed by the Web Developer & Designer role from October 2024. Builds, redesigns, CMS, localization and migrations for the agency’s clients.

JUN / OCT 2024

Web Development Intern, UCLA

University website migration to the Arty template, custom Web Components and front-end work with the university’s IT department.

2023

University technical & team roles

Scrum Master for RocketNet, coordinating an 11-student team, and technical support work for university computer labs.

2018 / JAN 2025

Telematics Engineering

Engineering degree at Universidad Centro Occidental Lisandro Alvarado.

Languages

Spanish and English.

Webflow certifications

Webflow Layouts Certification: Level 1
The Webflow Way

Outside the browser

Poodles, fantasy worlds and the visual language of playing cards. Those interests are part of the personality of Pancratzia.
